The Company issued KShs 600,000,000, 5 year fixed rate loan notes with a coupon rate of 11.75% payable
semi-annually. The loan note issue date was 03 December 2007 and they were listed on the Nairobi Stock
Exchange on 07 December 2007. The loan notes are redeemable in full by 3rd December 2012. Payments
of principal are made semi annually and commenced on 03 June 2010 with the final payment due on 03
December 2012. Interest payments on the loan notes commenced on 03 June 2009 and are payable semi-
annually thereafter in arrears.
